svg.title: Chicago 1871: retained terrain readings on the original 1870 Mitchell map
svg.desc: Source-pixel lines show watercourse centrelines, the outer lake edge, lagoon and park or cemetery outlines. Numbered circles mark retained bridge locations. These are generalized plan readings, not surveyed banks, bridge footprints or evidence of an exact October 1871 shoreline. The full original scan remains visible.

svg.text: Read the terrain against Mitchell’s 1870 map
Retained source-pixel readings from the 1871 city plan. These generalized lines do not establish surveyed banks.
Bridge symbols mark positions, not span length or structure form. Use browser zoom to inspect the original ink.
Bridge points · numbered; not span footprints
Open circle: map-attested span outside the report table
